Types of Recruitment Services in Dubai

Recruitment in the UAE means searching, finding, and hiring the ideal candidate for a particular position. With us, you can obtain different services that will help you streamline any type of recruitment you may need. These include:

  • Retained Recruitment: This service is ideal for high-level roles where a certain type of skill or experience is necessary.
  • Contingency Recruitment: This approach can be useful for filling vacancies that are not that difficult to fulfill; such as, entry-level or low-level positions.
  • Recruitment Process Outsourcing (RPO): RPO services are perfect for companies looking to improve their recruitment process when hiring a high volume of employees.
  • Executive Search: This type of service focuses on finding the perfect applicants for executive-level positions that need a certain type of experience.
